title: Ranald Bannerman's Boyhood - The Glimmer of Twilight
summary:
Ranald Bannerman's Boyhood by . George MacDonald is mainly known for his fantasy works and fairy tales such as At the Back of the North Wind and the Princess and the Goblin. However, during his life he was more famous for many more realistic novels. . . among them the somewhat autobiographical Ranald Bannerman's Boyhood.
